title: Why do buildings in Dubai have a 10 digit number?
note: Every number in the reel is made up (12345 67890 and the two on the building), and the square code on the plaque is a pattern, not a readable code. The plaque, building, map and vehicles are generic drawings.

facts.said: Buildings carry a 10 digit number on a plaque at the entrance.

sources.name: Gulf News, Makani number: what is it and why do you need it?

facts.said: It is called Makani, which means "my location" in Arabic.

sources.name: Gulf News, Makani number: what is it and why do you need it?

facts.said: The number comes from a geographic coordinate standard and finds the entrance to within about one metre.

sources.name: Gulf News, Makani number: what is it and why do you need it?
The National, New geographic address system launched in Dubai

facts.said: Big buildings get a different number for each entrance.

sources.name: Emirates 24/7 (WAM), Dubai's e address system begins in October (Aug 2015)
Dubai Municipality, Makani public web service access (PDF)

facts.said: You can share the number instead of describing the way.

sources.name: Gulf News, Makani to cut response time in Dubai emergencies

facts.said: Taxis can use it, and it helps emergency teams reach you faster.
